cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Credit for the Discovery
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that you found the clue, saw through the deception, or designed the successful scheme.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. On tomorrow's house tour, will you say my diagram revealed the hidden doorway?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mum spent all week stripping that wall.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Credit her work. Then say who spotted the door before we stripped it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll let you open it for the visitors.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Introduce me as the person who found it, or they'll think I'm holding it for them.

mechanism: A corrects the distinction between identifying, uncovering and demonstrating a hidden doorway to secure discovery credit.
confusable: Wanting visibility alone misses D129; A must have the discovery named rather than merely appear on the tour.
comparison: An embodied tour role differs from editing a report's attribution line.
seedUse: Keep the diagram, Mum's stripping work and door-opening offer; let A separate their contributions precisely.
